[head=2][color=#e8b04b]Banking and Credits[/color][/head]
Your personal bank balance belongs to your current character. Physical [color=#44cc00]credits[/color] can be carried, traded, deposited, or lost like any other item.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Using a Civil Bank ATM[/color][/head]
- Activate the ATM to open your account. - To deposit, insert a stack of accepted credits into the ATM's cash slot, enter the amount, and press [bold]Deposit[/bold]. Any unused credits remain in the slot. - To withdraw, enter an amount no greater than your balance and press [bold]Withdraw[/bold]. The ATM dispenses physical credits. - Remove any remaining cash from the slot before walking away.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Safe trading[/color][/head]
Most player-to-player deals use physical credit chits. Count the payment, agree on the price before transferring property, and keep written contracts or receipts for important faction business. A bank balance does not protect cash or goods already handed to another player.
For purchasing a vessel, continue to [textlink="Buying and Selling Ships" link="Shipyard"].
